title: History at Plymouth Church: Theodore Hamm, Brooklyn Historian
summary: Join us at Plymouth for a lecture by historian Theodore Hamm, speaking on his book Frederick Douglass in Brooklyn.

modules.html:
Ted Hamm is the editor of Frederick Douglass in Brooklyn, a collection of the legendary abolitionist's speeches. According to The New York Times' Sam Roberts, Hamm "persuasively and passionately makes the case that Brooklyn became a powerful forum" for Douglass. Plymouth's Henry Ward Beecher and Theodore Tilton became two of Douglass' foremost allies.

Hamm chairs the journalism program and teaches New York City history at St. Joseph's University, New York, in Clinton Hill, Brooklyn.


This lecture is free and open to the public.

This lecture will be in Plymouth's Reception Room.

Enter at 75 Hicks Street.

Doors open at 6:30PM.The lecture begins at 7:00PM.


Plymouth’s History Ministry speaker series’ is designed to give a 21st Century audience of all ages information on the history of the church, the history of New York City and Brooklyn, and the history of the United States. Knowing more about our past can inform our future and inspire the actions we take as an individual and a church, community and country.

title: Space Tech Summit

modules.html:
Global Speakers, Partners, Attendees Will Convene For 3rd Annual Global Space Tech Summit

Space Tech Summit brings together hundreds of entrepreneurs, pioneers, and creatives under one roof to address humanity’s greatest challenges via space technology. The summit also serves to convene key private and public stakeholders that can extend access to space industry developments to mainstream audiences. Every year the program welcomes global speakers and partners with unique perspectives on the future of Space and how one can be a part of it.

Today there are over 88+ mainstream annual conferences for space experts and potential enthusiasts. Yet as space becomes a more relevant part of our future reality- the ecosystem continues to gather only space experts, astronauts and researchers. Space Tech Summit asks- what happens when we invite the creatives, entrepreneurs, authors, actors, athletes and other ecosystem builders of society to the "future of space" conversation?

In 2018 the theme focused on “The Future Exploration and Commercialization of Space'' with an analysis of ecosystem influencers that drives the space industry to new heights such as startups, SME's and enterprises, VC funds, angel investors, research think tanks, governments and corporate innovators. In 2019, for the 50th Anniversary of the Moon Landing, the theme focused on “Lessons of 50 Years of Space Race History and What it Means for Humanity’s Future”. In 2020, during the pandemic year, Space Tech Summit convened micro virtual roundtables on how space technology can impact global grand challenges.

This year's theme is “From Space Travel to Space Cities - The New Era of the Space Tech Movement” where there will be a heavy dialogue on influencers who are driving the space race to make humans a multi planetary species by 2050. The summit will also highlight sub themes like “A Look at How to Relocate to Space in the Future” , “How startups can disrupt the future of space” and “The Current Applications of Space Technologies on Earth”.

Join the annual program as it discusses how society can revive the global space race and accelerate the commercialisation and impact of this dynamic industry sector.

This year the summit aims to increase the line up of speakers to facilitate

  • More on site workshop training
  • Networking round tables
  • Live Q/A sessions with speakers and sponsors
  • Attendee spotlight features

"This summit is not only for the innovators of today but also for the game-changers of tomorrow. From Elon Musk's SpaceX to Richard Branson's Virgin Galactic to Peter Diamandis's International Space University, the acceleration of space as a final tech frontier can be sparked by anyone who has an interest and passion for this movement. As a leader in ecosystem acceleration, we at GSE are proud to continue the legacy of space exploration." Einstein Ntim- Partner @ Global Startup Ecosystem.

title: Ming-Na Wen celebrates HAVE YOU EATEN YET? at B&N Union Square
summary: B&N Union Square in New York City welcomes Ming-Na Wen to celebrate HAVE YOU EATEN YET? on Monday, October 5th at 6PM.

modules.html:
Join Barnes & Noble - Union Square in New York City on Monday, October 5th at 6PM as we welcome legendary actress and Asian American icon, Ming-Na Wen to celebrate her cookbook, HAVE YOU EATEN YET? This heartfelt collection of stories and recipes weaves together Ming-Na's childhood in her family’s Pittsburgh Chinese restaurant with the dishes she now cooks at home for loved ones and friends.

.................................................................................................................

To make this event safe and enjoyable for all attendees, please read the below guidelines ahead of buying a ticket, so you know what to expect on the day.

TICKETING INFORMATION

Book Admission - $38.11 (Admission + one pre-signed copy of HAVE YOU EATEN YET?: Family Recipes from a Restaurant Daughter (A Cookbook)): **LIMITED QUANTITY AVAILABLE**:

A ticket PER PERSON includes:

  • One pre-signed copy of HAVE YOU EATEN YET? (out 10/6/26).
  • Admission to the event space and photo line with Ming-Na Wen.
  • **This ticket option is intended for those attending this event in person. For those unable to attend, shipping will be available for those who have purchased a Shipped Book ONLY ticket.**


NO ADMITTANCE, Shipped Book ONLY - $45.10 (one signed copy of HAVE YOU EATEN YET?: Family Recipes from a Restaurant Daughter (A Cookbook) + Shipping): **LIMITED QUANTITY AVAILABLE**: A ticket PER PERSON INCLUDES:

  • One signed copy of HAVE YOU EATEN YET? shipped to you.
  • This ticket is only for those who would like a signed copy of HAVE YOU EATEN YET? shipped to them. This ticket DOES NOT gain admittance to the in-person event at B&N Union Square
  • **This ticket option is not available for P.O. Boxes, Puerto Rico addresses, and international addresses. Any non US orders, Puerto Rico or P.O. Box mailing addresses will be cancelled and refunded.**


Ming-Na will pose for photos. A B&N staff member will be on-hand to take your photo.

All copies of HAVE YOU EATEN YET? will be pre-signed. There will be no personalization. No additional books or memorabilia will be signed.

Ticket holders will be admitted into the event beginning at 5:30 PM the day of the event. Please have a copy of your ticket available (either printed out or on your phone) for check in.

Please arrive by 6PM in order to secure your seat in the event space. Late arrivals may only have access to standing room and may not have the opportunity to meet the author.


GUIDELINES

Please note that Eventbrite is the only authorized dealer for this event. Each person, regardless of age, must have a ticket to enter.

No large bags will be permitted into the event.

No memorabilia will be signed at this event.

Any gifts for the author will be collected prior to the photo line.


REFUNDS

Attendees can receive refunds up to 24 hours before the event start time.

If you are unable to attend the event, Barnes & Noble - Union Square will hold your book for seven days after the event. Please contact the store to arrange your pickup.

Should this event be canceled, all customers will be refunded their ticket price to the original method of payment per Eventbrite's refund policy.


All event guidelines are subject to change.

If you have any additional questions, please call the store directly at: 212-253-0810.

Barnes & Noble reserves the right to make new rules and orders in its sole discretion with regard to COVID-19 at any time and any person not abiding by the Barnes & Noble directives will be refused entrance or directed to leave the premises.

_______________________________________________________________________________________

ABOUT HAVE YOU EATEN YET?: Family Recipes from a Restaurant Daughter (A Cookbook):

A heartfelt collection of stories and recipes from beloved actress and Asian American icon Ming-Na Wen, weaving together her childhood in her family’s Pittsburgh Chinese restaurant with the dishes she now cooks at home for loved ones and friends.

Legendary actress and Asian American icon Ming-Na Wen is best known for dozens of film and television roles including her breakout part in the film adaptation of Amy Tan’s bestselling novel The Joy Luck Club, the voice of Disney’s acclaimed Mulan, several years on the Emmy Award–winning ER, her part as Agent May on Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D., her role as Fennec Shand on the Star Wars franchise shows The Mandalorian and The Book of Boba Fett, and much more. Now Ming-Na invites fans into her kitchen to share a lifetime of recipes and stories that began in her parents’ beloved Pittsburgh restaurant—the Chinatown Inn, which is still open today—forever making food the center of her world. In this heartfelt tribute to her heritage, Ming-Na is sharing both traditional Chinese family recipes as well as recipes for her own creations that she cooks in her own home.

Have You Eaten Yet? is the ultimate love letter to food and family, offering delicious, accessible recipes for every occasion. In chapters like Restaurant Classics, you’ll learn to master iconic dishes like The Best Egg Rolls, Simple Wonton Soup, and Shrimp Fried Rice. Discover family secrets from her father in Feasts from Chef Baba with recipes like his tender Prime Rib and comforting Winter Melon Soup. Straight from Ming-Na’s Kitchen, you’ll find crowd-pleasers like Shrimp with Garlic Noodles and the show-stopping Dragon Fruit Cheesecake Cups. Ming-Na even gives readers advice on perfecting rice, her guide to condiments, and restaurant-inspired tips for prepping sauces, broths, and dry spices.

Filled with personal stories, heartwarming memories, practical tips, and even never-before-seen family photos, Have You Eaten Yet? is an essential guide for anyone looking to explore the rich flavors of Chinese American cuisine.

ABOUT Ming-Na Wen:

Born in Macau then moving to Hong Kong later and eventually the United States at the age of six, celebrated actress Ming-Na Wen spent much of her youth learning about food in her family’s Pittsburgh restaurant, the Chinatown Inn, now a historic landmark and the only remaining establishment from the city’s original Chinatown. As an adult and now an Asian American icon, Ming-Na has appeared in television and films ranging from her breakout starring role in The Joy Luck Club, based on Amy Tan’s bestselling novel, to Karate Kid Legends in 2025. She broke barriers with her seven-year run as Dr. Chen on the Emmy Award–winning NBC series ER and was beloved by a younger generation for voicing the titular role in Disney’s acclaimed Mulan. She went on to be named a Disney Legend thanks to roles such as Agent May on Marvel’s Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. and Fennec Shand on the Star Wars franchise shows The Mandalorian and The Book of Boba Fett. With hundreds of other roles she’s played over decades, Ming-Na was awarded a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame in 2023. She lives with her husband Eric in Los Angeles, and she is proud that they have raised their two beautiful children, Michaela and Cooper, to be passionate foodies.

title: A COURT OF SPLINTERED HARMONY Midnight Release Party at B&N
summary: Barnes & Noble Union Square in NYC hosts a Midnight Release Party to celebrate A COURT OF SPLINTERED HARMONY on Mon., Oct. 26th at 9:30PM.

modules.html:
What was broken will be remade.

Join Barnes & Noble - Union Square in New York City on Monday, October 26th at 9:30PM for a Midnight Release Party as we celebrate the next book in Sarah J. Maas' iconic series, A COURT OF SPLINTERED HARMONY. Return to Prythian for another dazzling adventure.

There will be games, crafts and other activities. Books will be handed out to attendees at Midnight to celebrate the release.

*Please note, Sarah J. Maas will NOT be in attendance*

.................................................................................................................

To make this event safe and enjoyable for all attendees, please read the below guidelines ahead of buying a ticket, so you know what to expect on the day.

TICKETING INFORMATION

Book Admission - $34.84 (Admission + one copy of A COURT OF SPLINTERED HARMONY): **LIMITED QUANTITY AVAILABLE**:

A ticket PER PERSON includes:

  • One copy of A COURT OF SPLINTERED HARMONY (out 10/27/26).
  • Admission to the Midnight Release Party and all activities.


Ticket holders will be admitted into the event beginning at 9:15 PM. Please have a copy of your ticket available (either printed out or on your phone) for check-in.

Please arrive by 11:30PM in order to enter Barnes & Noble Union Square.


GUIDELINES

Please note that Eventbrite is the only authorized dealer for this event. Each person, regardless of age, must have a ticket to enter.

Some outside queuing will be needed before entering the store. Please dress appropriately.

Please be mindful of any personal belongings you bring with you. There will not be a place to store them.

No large bags will be permitted into the event.


REFUNDS

Attendees can receive refunds up to 24 hours before the event start time.

If you are unable to attend the event, Barnes & Noble - Union Square will hold your book for seven days after the event. Please contact the store to arrange your pickup.

Should this event be canceled, all customers will be refunded their ticket price to the original method of payment per Eventbrite's refund policy.


All event guidelines are subject to change.

If you have any additional questions, please call the store directly at: 212-253-0810.

Barnes & Noble reserves the right to make new rules and orders in its sole discretion with regard to COVID-19 at any time and any person not abiding by the Barnes & Noble directives will be refused entrance or directed to leave the premises.

_______________________________________________________________________________________

ABOUT A COURT OF SPLINTERED HARMONY:

Romance, danger, and intrigue await you in the breathtaking sixth book in the #1 bestselling Court of Thorns and Roses (ACOTAR) series.

What was broken will be remade.

Deep in the heart of the continent, Koschei the Deathless is stirring. Though he's been bound to a mountain lake for millennia, the insidious threat of his return now spreads across the Fae territories, attracting powerful allies hell-bent on reclaiming what was once theirs: the human lands.

The Night Court will not stand idly by while innocents are attacked. But with Prythian still piecing itself together in the wake of the devastating Hybern War, the task of uniting is proving more difficult by the day.

To make matters worse, those who rule and protect the Night Court are reeling from recent betrayals and revealed truths. The rifts dividing them seem insurmountable.

But to defeat Koschei's creeping shadow, they must find a way back to each other and resurrect their former alliances. To survive, they must find a way to repair the splintered harmony all around them.

The Court of Thorns and Roses series includes:
A Court of Thorns and Roses
A Court of Mist and Fury
A Court of Wings and Ruin
A Court of Frost and Starlight
A Court of Silver Flames
A Court of Splintered Harmony
A Court of Forgotten Melody

title: Altars Conference 2027 (Weekend)
summary: We are hungry to see a historic move of God in our day, and we long to see the manifest presence of God break into our cities.

modules.html:
January 28th - 30th

Altars is a movement and prayer conference hosted in New York City that exists to equip and connect God’s people to contend for spiritual awakening in our time, wherever they are.

We invite you to join us for our fifth annual Altars gathering!

Altars was born in New York City, birthed out of PRAY.NYC and Church of the City New York.

The experience will be the same for both Weekend and Weekday Conferences. We host both to provide more space for folks to attend. Registration to one conference applies to those dates only.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the Altars Conference (Weekend) and Altars Conference (Weekday)?
faqs.answer: The conference experience will be the same for both Weekend and Weekday Conferences. We have decided to offer a second conference to make more space for folks to attend! Admission to one conference DOES NOT allow you admission to the other conference.

faqs.question: Should I attend both?
faqs.answer: No! We ask that you attend on the dates that are best for you to make space for others to attend, instead of buying admission for both conferences.

faqs.question: Can I access the content for both afterword?
faqs.answer: Yes! All sessions for BOTH conference will be made available to conference attendees of either conferences after the conference!

faqs.question: Can I get a refund?
faqs.answer: Please check our altars.nyc website FAQ section to see our refund policy.

faqs.question: Where can I find more detailed FAQs?
faqs.answer: On the Altars website at altars.nyc!
